messages:
Ava Morris: quick sync — got feedback from CS: CSV role import is working but CSVs often miss SSO domains, resulting in a bunch of failed invites. thinking: detect domains during import and show inline SSO compatibility column before confirm.
Ken Patel: love that. UX: show a small status column 'SSO status' (OK / Enforced / Unknown) and let users toggle 'Send as pending' per-row. default to pending when Enforced.
Lydia Cho: accessibility: status column must have an aria-label and text fallback (don't rely on color). announce summary after import validation: '12 rows OK, 3 require SSO review'.
Ravi Kapoor: engineering caveat: domain checks are async; run in parallel and update rows in place. debounce not needed for batch. add a global 'recheck domains' button in case of transient failures.
Ava Morris: copy idea for the confirm modal: 'Review import: some accounts may be blocked by SSO. Mark as pending to avoid failed sends.' include link 'Why does this happen?' that opens a dialog with short explanation.
Ken Patel: UX for the roles grid after import: sticky header with filter chips + a pinned 'Import status' strip that shows number of pending invites and a CTA 'Open Audit (filtered)'. that deep-link must use a token, not raw emails, unless user opts in.
Lydia Cho: SR note: dialog needs focus trap, link should have rel=noopener and announce 'Opens Audit Log in new tab, filtered by import'. the import validation summary should be in an aria-live region.
Ravi Kapoor: CSV template update: include a column 'force_pending' and 'include_in_audit_link' so power users can control behavior. default include_in_audit_link=false to avoid exposing PII.
Ava Morris: microcopy tweak: standardize on 'Enforce SSO' in toggles and 'SSO enforced' in status badges. also add helper text: 'Enforced: members must sign in via your SSO provider.'
Ken Patel: small keyboard flow: after import finishes, focus goes to the summary toast with 'Review results' button. pressing Enter opens the import results panel. don't auto-open panels.
Lydia Cho: color contrast: status badges must meet 4.5:1; add a 1px outline and text labels. run color-blind sims.
Ravi Kapoor: action items — Ken: prototype import table + sticky import strip; Lydia: SR text + live region behaviors; Ava: update CSV template & copy; I'll add API notes for tokenized audit links. target: PR by next Tue.
A11yBot: checklist added (#A11Y-534): aria-live summary, dialog focus trap, contrast checks, no PII in links by default.
